title: Permutation Lister
description: Prints a chosen permutation of named objects without listing the others.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: PERM.BAS (More Voice)
versions.note: Different code from the separate Permutations program on tape.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
5 CLEAR 500
6 DEFINT A-Z:DEF FNM(N,B)=N-INT(N/B)*B
10 INPUT "NUMBER OF OBJECTS";T
12 DIM TR(T),N$(T)
15 FF=1:FOR I=1 TO T:PRINT"NAME OF OBJECT #";I;:INPUTN$(I):FF=FF*I:NEXTI:PRINT "NUMBER OF PERMUTATIONS IS";FF
30 PRINT:INPUT"WHICH PERMUTATION WOULD YOU LIKE (0 TO QUIT)";II:IF II=0 THEN RUN ELSEGOSUB1000
40 FOR N=1 TO T:IF N=1 THEN FX=1:GX=TELSE FX=FX*GX:GX=GX-1
50 I= FNM(II-1,FF/FX)*GX*FX/FF+1:GOSUB 2000:PRINTN$(D);" ";:NEXTN:PRINT
60 GOTO 30
1000 TA=1
1010 IF TA>T THEN RETURN
1020 FOR I=TA TO T STEP TA:TR(I)=TA:NEXTI

versions.startupSource:
2 CLEAR 500
5 DEFINTA-Z:DEF FNI#(E#)=VAL(LEFT$(STR$(E#),INSTR(STR$(E#)+".",".")))
6 DEF FNM#(N#,B#)=N#-FNI#(N#/B#)*B#
10 INPUT "NUMBER OF OBJECTS";T
12 DIM TR(T),N$(T)
15 FF#=1:FOR I=1 TO T:PRINT"NAME OF OBJECT #";I;:INPUTN$(I):FF#=FF#*I:NEXTI:PRINT "NUMBER OF PERMUTATIONS IS";FF#
30 PRINT:INPUT"WHICH PERMUTATION WOULD YOU LIKE (0 TO QUIT)";II#:IF II#=0 THEN RUN ELSEGOSUB1000
40 FOR N=1 TO T:IF N=1 THEN FX#=1:GX=TELSE FX#=FX#*GX:GX=GX-1
45 'PRINT FX#,GX:STOP
50 I= FNI#(FNM#(II#-1,FF#/FX#)*GX*FX#/FF#+1):GOSUB 2000:PRINTN$(D);" ";:NEXTN:PRINT
60 GOTO 30
1000 TA=1
